Name: Blue-Collar Imp
SectorAbilities:
1P: defend 2.
1A: extract. Each of your imps acts as 2 nodes during distribution.
CombatAbilities: Protect 2.
PalaceAmbition: Each time you extract, immediatelly take 1 soul from sediment into your reserves, skipping distribution.

Name: Fiendy Recruiter
SectorAbilities:
1A: extract, promote.
1A: give up to 6 souls to a player with imps in the active sector. For every 2 souls given, replace 1 of their imps with your imp.
PalaceAmbition: After getting dominated by another agent in any sector, place 1 imp on any sector.

Name: Chief Archivist of Dis
PalaceAmbition: Each time you would discard an agent card, you may choose to spend 1 favor to keep the card instead.

Name: Horned Middle Manager
SectorAbilities:
0P: defend 1.
1A: extract, promote.
CombatAbilities: After this combat, extract in the active sector. Treat the imps from the opposing side as nodes under your control.
PalaceAmbition: This agent cannot become the archdevil.

Name: Loan Shark
SectorAbilities: 1A: extract, attack.
CombatAbilities: Execute 1.
PalaceAmbition: As a machination: give 4 souls from reserves to any player; if you do, take 1 favor from that player.

Name: Soul Trader
SectorAbilities:
1A: destroy 1 of your imps in the active sector. Then contract 1 agent.
1A: heal 1, move 1.
PalaceAmbition: When an imp is destroyed in this sector, you may allow the owning player to pay 1 soul from their reserves into this coffer; if they do, they place 1 fresh imp in this sector.

Name: Soulforger
SectorAbilities:
3P: at the start of combat in this sector, place 1 imp.
1A: promote.
1A: heal 1.
1A: move.
CombatAbilities: At the start of combat, place 1 imp in the active sector.
PalaceAmbition: Each time you promote and place at least 2 imps, place 1 additional imp.

Name: Ten-Eyed Micro-Manager
SectorAbilities:
1A: select any sector; use nodes from the selected sector to extract in the active sector.
2A: extract. Target any sector.
CombatAbilities: Gain 1 combat strength for each other player with imps in this sector.
PalaceAmbition: This pit lord is counted twice as a node during soul distribution of an extract ability.

Name: Urban Planner
SectorAbilities: 1A: extract. Take 1 favor for each player with imps in the active sector.
CombatAbilities: Protect 1.
PalaceAmbition: The sediment of this sector is counted twice as a node during soul distribution from limbo.

Name: Apostatic Courrier
SectorAbilities:
1P: support.
1A: move 4, move 4.
CombatAbilities: At the start of combat, move 1 from an adjacent sector.
PalaceAmbition: Each time you move, you may take 1 imp owned by another player as part of the move.

Name: Corporate Gravedigger
SectorAbilities: 1A: extract, move 5.
CombatAbilities: If you win the combat, place 1 favor from supply on the acting agent.
PalaceAmbition: Each time you discard an agent card you may choose to place it on the top of the appropriate contracting deck.

Name: Friday Afternoon Ghost
SectorAbilities:
1P: support.
1A: move any number of your imps in the active sector to any number of sectors with your imps.
1A: heal 4.
CombatAbilities: Before combat strength is counted, heal 4. This may target supporting imps.
PalaceAmbition: Your heal abilities may target any sector.

Name: Hellhound Master
SectorAbilities:
1P: patrol. May target other patrol abilities.
1A: attack, move 4.
PalaceAmbition: When agent cards are revealed during planning step in operations phase you may spend 1 soul from reserves into any coffer. If you do, replace your acting agent with another agent from hand in the sector associated with that coffer.

Name: Performance Review Pit Lord
SectorAbilities: 1A: select an acting agent in this sector. The player must return the agent to their hand and place another agent, if able.
CombatAbilities: Any favors added on top of the opponent's acting agent in this sector increase your combat strength by 1.
PalaceAmbition: If this agent failed to dominate, return it to the owner's hand instead of discarding.

Name: Sinner Intake Officer
SectorAbilities:
1A: promote.
1A: heal 2.
1A: move 3.
2A: promote, heal 2, move 4.
CombatAbilities: If you're attacking, execute 2. If you're defending, protect 2.
PalaceAmbition: Each time you heal you may target 1 additional imp.

Name: Stealthy Auditor
SectorAbilities:
1P: support.
2P: after another agent pays energy in this sector, they must pay 1 more energy.
1A: move 5. May target active sector as destination from another sector.
PalaceAmbition: At any point: view the top card of any contracting deck.

Name: Tenured Director
SectorAbilities: 1A: move 3. Then, switch places with an acting agent you own in another sector.
CombatAbilities: If you're defending, the combat strength of each imp on the attacking side is reduced by 1 (minimum of 0).
PalaceAmbition: When an acting agent would reach 0 energy, you may take 1 soul from your reserves into the coffers of that agent's sector; if you do, that agent gains 1 energy.

Name: Unpaid Infern
SectorAbilities:
1P: support. Gain 1 energy if a supported combat is won.
1A: heal 3.
CombatAbilities: If you lose the combat, your opponent must give you 2 souls from reserves, if able.
PalaceAmbition: Each of your acting agent starts with 1 more energy.

Name: War Machine Integrator
SectorAbilities:
1P: patrol. May target adjacent sectors.
1A: attack. May choose adjacent sector as a target.
CombatAbilities: Execute 2. Target opponent's imps in any sector.
PalaceAmbition: Each favor on any acting agent you control adds 1 more to domination count.

Name: Casual Friday Lich
SectorAbilities:
1P: when a number of imps would be destroyed in this sector, set them as exhausted and do not destroy them.
1A: promote, attack.
CombatAbilities: Power of enemy agent is reduced to 0 for this combat.
PalaceAmbition: If you are the attacker and lose, your imps do not become exhausted.

Name: Contract Lawyer
SectorAbilities:
1P: defend 3.
1P: patrol ability that targetted you has no effect, unless the player targetting you gives 1 soul from their reserves.
1A: attack.
CombatAbilities: Immediatelly move the opponent to the bottom of the scoring order.
PalaceAmbition: Each time a combat you participate in is tied (before the tie is resolved), take 1 soul from limbo to reserves.

Name: Crag Warden
SectorAbilities:
1P: defend 2.
1P: patrol. May target defend abilities.
1A: attack.
CombatAbilities: Protect 2. Supporting imps are not counted in this combat.
PalaceAmbition: Reduce the number of imps able to move to this sector by 1 (move X which targets this sector is treated as X-1 instead).

Name: Deep Pit Lord
SectorAbilities: 1A: exhaust up to 3 imps in the active sector. Attack.
CombatAbilities: Execute 4. May convert the destroyed enemy imps into your fresh imps.
PalaceAmbition: When contracting agents you may destroy X of your imps. Reduce the bidding level cost by X.

Name: Expense Report Fury
SectorAbilities:
1P: patrol.
1A: attack, attack.
CombatAbilities: If you win the combat, switch any 2 player positions in any single order.
PalaceAmbition:
Your agents acting in this sector gain the following sector abilities:
1P: patrol.
1A: attack.

Name: The Dark Mage
SectorAbilities: 1A: attack, extract.
CombatAbilities: When agent cards are revealed, you may force the opponent to select another card from their hand, if able.
PalaceAmbition: At the start of combat when agent cards are revealed you may give 1 favor to the opponent. If you do, switch your agent with another one from your hand.

Name: The Shadow Syndicate
SectorAbilities: 1A: extract. Treat the sigil of wrath as a node under your control.
CombatAbilities: Protect 1. Gain 1 combat strength for each sector ruled by you.
PalaceAmbition: After each domination step in palace phase, if this agent is a pit lord, take 2 souls from coffers of this sector to reserves.

Name: Stygian Frostrider
SectorAbilities:
1P: whenever imps are moved into this sector, move 3.
1A: attack, move 2.
CombatAbilities: If your opponent has a higher position on the operating order, gain 1 combat strength and execute 1.
PalaceAmbition: After resolving move, you may attack the target sector with the moved imps.
